article.headline: Jahni Summers scores 22, South Dakota wins 99-47 against Clarke
article.description: — Jahni Summers scored 22 points as South Dakota beat Clarke 99-47 on Friday.
article.linkText: Jahni Summers scores 22, South Dakota wins 99-47 against Clarke
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Jahni Summers scored 22 points as South Dakota beat Clarke 99-47 on Friday. Summers shot 9 for 11, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Coyotes (5-5). Vince Buzelis added 14 points while shooting 7 of 11 from the field while they also had three steals. Stef van Bussel had 10 points and shot 3 of 7 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line. Lovre Stanovic led the Pride in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Clarke also got eight points from Dion Doyle. Ivan Vukusic also had six points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
